high_attraction_beacons.title: BATTERY_EXCISE_TAX_EVIDENCE_RECONCILER
high_attraction_beacons.chinese_title: 电池消费税抵扣与减免证据对账器
high_attraction_beacons.mechanism: A self-serve reconciliation layer imports battery purchase/import/processing tax documents plus production-consumption records, produces the statutory battery tax-credit ledger, flags unreconciled eligible credits and missing exemption evidence, and generates accountant-reviewable declaration inputs while failing closed on ambiguous tax classification.
high_attraction_beacons.timing_event: China battery excise-tax policy changed on 2026-09-01; relevant batteries moved to 2% tax, rising to 4% from 2027-09-01, while specified new-technology batteries remain temporarily exempt subject to national-standard evidence.
high_attraction_beacons.direct_value_link: Credits depend on actual production usage and valid tax documents; exemption depends on qualified test reports and SKU/accounting/invoice alignment. Missed reconciliation can directly affect tax cash outflow.
high_attraction_beacons.operator_asset_hypothesis: Reusable import adapters for ERP/Excel/invoice exports, rule-versioned reconciliation tests, exception taxonomy and non-identifying reconciliation patterns. This is hypothesis only and must survive generic-agent/ERP-incumbent falsification.
high_attraction_beacons.fail_closed_boundary: Do not decide genuinely ambiguous product tax classification, replace a tax professional, submit tax declarations, or assert eligibility without the required source records and test evidence.

examined_formations.title: GENERIC_AI_AGENT_SECURITY_TESTING_PLATFORM
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Policy and procurement prove current paid demand, but cloud security vendors, professional labs, public research platforms and emerging certification/testing frameworks already occupy the generic evaluation surface.

examined_formations.title: CBAM_EVIDENCE_AND_VERIFICATION_WORKBENCH
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The 2026 verification phase creates real cost and evidence-chain pressure, but dedicated Chinese CBAM SaaS and full-service platforms already sell monitoring, supplier collaboration, verification preparation and reporting.

examined_formations.title: PPE_SELECTION_AND_STANDARD_COMPLIANCE_ENGINE
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Forty mandatory PPE standards took effect on 2026-09-01, but the obvious layer is public-rule selection plus established product testing/certification and supplier catalogs.

examined_formations.title: BATTERY_FULL_LIFECYCLE_TRACEABILITY_CONNECTOR
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Battery traceability is mandatory and machine-readable, but the national lifecycle traceability platform already owns the reporting/control surface.

examined_formations.title: INDUSTRIAL_ROBOT_SAFETY_ASSESSMENT_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.evidence_summary: New mandatory industrial-robot safety projects increase future demand, but risk assessment/testing is already anchored in specialist institutes, certification bodies and expert system integration.
